theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (z₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ φ z₀) → ∃ (V₀ O : Set (Euclid d)) (g : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₀ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ z₀ ∈ V₀ ∧ V₀ ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g O ∧ MapsTo g O V₀ ∧ (∀ y ∈ O, φ (g y) = y) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₀, φ z ∈ O ∧ g (φ z) = z
